Post 1

ASX 200 barely blinked — down just 8 pts to 9,263.60 Friday. But beneath the flat close, lithium surged and healthcare bled. The index sits just 0.36% from its 52-week high after a 3.19% weekly gain. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

⛏️ Materials led all sectors at +1.32% as lithium names ran hard. Healthcare dragged at -0.92%, Financials worse at -0.95%. Two sectors pulling in opposite directions tells you this wasn't a clean risk-on day. #ASX #mining #ausbiz

Post 3

🔺 Liontown surged 9.26% to AUD 1.18, topping the ASX 200. Pilbara and Elevra both gained over 6.5%. Lithium is staging a coordinated move — three names in the top five is not noise. #ASX #lithium #mining

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 6,107.05/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7027. A softer Aussie dollar amplifies gold returns for local holders — that's part of why Materials outperformed today. #ASX #gold #commodities

Post 5

Watch the AUD/USD 0.70 handle. A break below lifts commodity prices in local terms and supports Materials again. Does lithium extend its run next week or was Friday a one-day flush? Drop your call below. #ASX #ausbiz #lithium
